title: Cancel unused aliquot
purpose: Retain an unused aliquot and its test links as cancelled evidence rather than deleting them.

sections.title: Context and fields
paragraphs: Active internal staff with a laboratory role can read this workspace. Analysts can create and change preparation work. An admin has operational analyst access; a client account or superuser status alone does not grant it.
The title identifies the aliquot label. The Preparation panel displays Batch, Preparation method, Matrix and Actual start.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required explanation of why this unused aliquot is being cancelled. Whitespace alone is not accepted; the reason stays with actor and cancellation time.

items.label: Cancel aliquot
items.description: Cancels only an uncancelled aliquot that has never been used by any result revision. Checks run again under a lock. Closing batch membership does not by itself prevent this action. The identity, sample, covered tests and preparation history remain; the aliquot cannot be selected for new results.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the preparation batch without cancelling the aliquot.

sections.title: Used work
paragraphs: If any revision uses the aliquot, cancellation is refused. Record a new preparation instead. Cancelled physical aliquots still count toward preparation QC frequency; cancellation does not erase work performed.
